oracle.role: Primary behavioral reference for key sequences, displays, state transitions, results, and errors.
oracle.exception_policy: The six differences explicitly documented by Sharp are simulator limitations, not physical EL-506TS behavior. For those differences, the official operation guide or a physical EL-506TS outranks the simulator.
oracle.repo_policy: Store fingerprints and behavioral transcriptions only. Do not commit the simulator, its assets, its ReadMe, or captured images.

official_source.provenance: The local launcher and ReadMe hashes exactly match the corresponding entries in the official download observed on the verification date.

observed_host.vendor_support_note: Windows 11 is outside the bundled ReadMe support matrix but launched successfully.

launch.method: Run the launcher SFX with no arguments and leave its WinZip Self-Extractor window open while SHARP Calculator.exe is running.
preconditions: No prior EL_506TS_Simulator or SHARP Calculator process is running.
The launcher SHA-256 matches this profile.
Windows display scaling is 100 percent for pixel-comparison sessions.
The simulator is allowed to write to the user's temporary directory and Documents folder.
ready_assertions: The runtime window title exactly matches SHARP Calculator - EL-506TS.
The runtime executable SHA-256 and version match this profile.
The window is 772x665 px with a 766x636 px client area at 96 DPI.
SmallCalcPanel is 287x577 px and SegLcdWnd is 425x124 px.
teardown: Close the SHARP Calculator window normally.
Verify that both the runtime and Self-Extractor processes exit.
Delete only capture files created by the current test session.

reset_baseline.canonical_reset: Use the simulator chrome Reset control, not ON/C or a calculator memory-clear sequence.
documented_effects: Return the display format to its initial setting.
Return calculation mode to its initial setting.

observed_mode_probe.note: The simulator uses a dot beside the selected menu number instead of the physical calculator's blinking number.

automation.coordinate_policy: Resolve SmallCalcPanel on every session, express future calculator-key centers relative to its 287x577 bounds, and reject pixel-golden runs when DPI or panel dimensions differ.
automation.result_policy: Use the built-in Capture control, then compare the local image and store only a transcription and hash in Git.

known_simulator_differences.simulator_behavior: Does not turn itself off automatically.
known_simulator_differences.parity_policy: Treat as an officially documented simulator limitation and verify physical-device behavior separately.

known_simulator_differences.simulator_behavior: RANDOM, R-DICE, R-COIN, and R-INT produce fewer varieties or values.
known_simulator_differences.parity_policy: Do not artificially restrict the web calculator to the simulator's reduced sample set.
Use the physical-device behavior when defining final display timing.

known_simulator_differences.simulator_behavior: Stored memory is cleared when the simulator application closes.
known_simulator_differences.parity_policy: Do not infer physical memory persistence from simulator process lifetime.

known_simulator_differences.simulator_behavior: MODE, SET UP, M-CLR, RANDOM, and MATH menus show a dot beside the selected number instead of blinking the number.
known_simulator_differences.parity_policy: Use physical-device presentation for the final display while retaining the same selections and sequences.

known_simulator_differences.simulator_behavior: ALGB underlines the selected variable instead of blinking it.
known_simulator_differences.parity_policy: Use physical-device presentation for the final display while retaining the same prompt sequence.

evidence.scope: Reset effects, NORM1 default, NORMAL mode, and physical calculator behavior.
Product identity, release, requirements, reset procedure, capture behavior, license, and six simulator differences.
Runtime version, company, architecture, signature status, and executable fingerprint.
Launch lifecycle, Reset baseline, MODE probe, capture dimensions, repeatable capture hash, and clean shutdown.
Window/control identifiers, bounds, supported-pattern limits, and lack of key/LCD text exposure.

verification.method: Compared SHA-256 and byte length of both local files to the entries in two identical downloads of the official ZIP.
Launched the SFX, observed the exact runtime title, and fingerprinted the active runtime executable.
Reset and captured the LCD twice at 96 DPI; both 425x124 BMP files had the same SHA-256.
Closing the runtime window normally also closed the SFX wrapper; all test-created captures were removed.
